definition: A standard an agent can actually use with adequate epistemic warrant to distinguish correct from incorrect applications of a rule. Its practical availability and warrant are additional requirements beyond the extensional existence of a predicate on evidence.
note: Comparison sense only: no complete theory of epistemic warrant is asserted or formalized. Whether PI I.258/I.265 requires this or a different grammatical notion remains an open source-interpretive question. Do not infer it from the exact-classifier theorem.
